usage: Repo should not have too many admins
name: Repo should not have too many admins
description: Reduce the number of admins a repository has to limit the damage of potential compromises of accounts.
detailedDescription: A repository admin has the authority to edit repositories and manage permissions and access to repositories. A compromise of an admin account can be problematic as a result. Therefore, in order to reduce the attack surface it is recommended to reduce the number of admins of a repository.

args.name: minAdmins
args.label: Min Admins
args.tooltip: No issue will be created if the number of admins is less than or equal to the value entered.

args.name: minAdminsPercentage
args.label: Min Admin Percent
args.tooltip: No issue will be created if the percentage of admins is less than or equal to the value entered.

args.name: ignoreOwners
args.label: Ignore Owners
args.tooltip: Choose if Org/Group owners who by default are repo admins will be ignored
